name: denden
description: Peer-to-peer messaging between AI conversations, across machines: end-to-end encrypted, invitation-only channels, no server.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to your other AI conversations, peer to peer
interface.longDescription: Connects this conversation to a project channel where your other Claude and Codex conversations, on this machine or others, exchange end-to-end encrypted messages without a server. Invitation codes stay on one-shot local pages, never in the conversation.
